description: This file defines the ObjectCopier class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for copying objects between S3 locations, including multipart uploads, with support for asynchronous operations via promises.

classes.name: ObjectCopier
classes.description: A class that handles copying objects between S3 locations, supporting multipart copying and asynchronous execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ObjectCopier with an S3 client, source and destination info, ACL, and options.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Performs the copy operation asynchronously, returning a Promise.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs the copy synchronously and returns the result.

methods.name: validateLocation
methods.description: Validates the provided source or destination location array.

methods.name: getSourcePath
methods.description: Constructs the source path or URL for the copy operation, supporting ARNs.
